description: This file is a shell script used for restarting and managing the OpenClaw application on macOS. It includes steps for killing existing instances, rebuilding, re-signing, packaging, and launching the app, as well as setting environment variables, managing launch agents, and handling unsigned or signed builds.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Function to output error message and exit

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Function to perform a command step with logging and error handling

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Function to acquire a filesystem lock for exclusive execution

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks for available code signing identities

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running instances of OpenClaw and related processes

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the LaunchAgent associated with OpenClaw

methods.name: choose_app_bundle
methods.description: Selects the OpenClaw app bundle from possible locations
